👋 SR-190 ROAD CONDITIONS

Be prepared for winter conditions on Guardsman Pass

‼️ Slow down, especially on uphills and corners

🚨Guardsman Pass will be temporarily CLOSED tonight (10/12) at 9:30pm

🚧 Road Closure Update 🚧

SR-190 OPEN: Both directions. Flood control and debris clearing is complete.

📍Uphill: Open at mouth

📍Downhill: Open to the mouth

➡️ Plan ahead: More rain is forecasted over the next couple days. Weather related delays are possible.

10/11 8:47pm

🚧 Uphill Restriction Update 🚧

SR-190: Utah Transportation crew is working on clearing the culvert at Storm Mountain (MP 4.25) of debris

‼️No ETO to uphill traffic at this time
Heads up, Guardsman/Empire Pass travelers: https://x.com/UDOTcottonwoods/status/2109682425676865951

Construction for Weber Canyon Bridge replacement in progress, estimated to be complete late Spring. Expect one-way traffic with travel delays in the area. EB single-lane closure: Active day and night through Oct. 10. WB Single-lane closure: Active day and night through Oct. 15.

🦺I-84 CONSTRUCTION UPDATE

EB Single-lane closure: Active day and night through Oct. 10. 

WB Single-lane closure: Active day and night through Oct. 15. 

‼️ Strict 11-foot lane width restriction, no exceptions. 

Expect moderate delays and prepare to reduce speeds as you approach the lane drop.
